text: ὁ Λύκος ἵσταται καὶ ὀργίζεται. ἡ Γλαὺξ πάλιν φοβεῖται.
objects: a bright red leather ball about the size of a grapefruit
a white leather ball about the size of a grapefruit
a large gray boulder twice the size of Hyperbrephos
positioning: Hyperbrephos stands alert and ready, watching Lukos carefully
Glaux cowers again with both balls, looking terrified
Lukos stands up with an furious expression, baring his teeth and snarling
The bright red leather ball is held by the frightened Glaux
The white leather ball is also clutched by Glaux
The large gray boulder waits ominously nearby
